cards.title: Pesan Disadap
cards.text: Pindah ke Stasiun Radio dan langsung mainkan Dekode. Jika melewati START, terima gaji.
cards.textEn: Move to the Radio Station and play Decode. Collect salary if you pass START.

cards.title: Penyamaran Terbongkar
cards.text: Langsung masuk Penjara PIDE. Tidak melewati START.
cards.textEn: Go directly to PIDE Prison. Do not pass START.

cards.title: Informan Berbalik
cards.text: Ambil 1 kartu Bukti acak dari tangan pemain di kananmu, lihat, lalu kembalikan.
cards.textEn: Take 1 random Evidence card from the player on your right, look at it, then return it.

cards.title: Kejar-kejaran di Alfama
cards.text: Mundur 3 petak dan jalankan efek petak tujuan.
cards.textEn: Move back 3 tiles and resolve that tile.

cards.title: Surat Bebas Diplomatik
cards.text: Simpan kartu ini; pakai untuk keluar Penjara gratis. Boleh diperdagangkan.
cards.textEn: Keep this card; use it to leave Prison for free. May be traded.

cards.title: Kereta Malam
cards.text: Maju ke Kereta Rossio. Jika tak bertuan boleh dibeli; jika bertuan bayar 2× sewa jalur. Jika melewati START, terima gaji.
cards.textEn: Advance to Rossio Train. Buy it if unowned; if owned pay 2× route rent. Collect salary if you pass START.

cards.title: Undangan Kedutaan
cards.text: Maju ke Kedutaan Netral. Kamu boleh melakukan Tuduhan Akhir tanpa biaya. Jika melewati START, terima gaji.
cards.textEn: Advance to the Neutral Embassy. You may make a Final Accusation for free. Collect salary if you pass START.

cards.title: Panggilan Interogasi
cards.text: Maju ke Ruang Interogasi terdekat di depanmu dan ajukan Dugaan (Lokasi bebas).
cards.textEn: Advance to the nearest Interrogation Room ahead and make a Suggestion (any Location).

cards.title: Tiket ke Estoril
cards.text: Maju ke Kasino Estoril dan boleh bertaruh.
cards.textEn: Advance to Estoril Casino and you may bet.

cards.title: Kurir Tertangkap
cards.text: Tunjukkan 1 kartu Bukti pilihanmu ke pemain di kirimu secara rahasia.
cards.textEn: Secretly show 1 Evidence card of your choice to the player on your left.

cards.title: Sumber di Pelabuhan
cards.text: Maju ke Gudang 7. Jika melewati START, terima gaji.
cards.textEn: Advance to Warehouse 7. Collect salary if you pass START.

cards.title: Penyadapan Telepon
cards.text: Lihat 1 kartu Bukti acak dari pemain dengan uang terbanyak.
cards.textEn: Look at 1 random Evidence card from the richest player.

cards.title: Suap Penjaga
cards.text: Bayar 25 kepada setiap pemain lain yang masih aktif.
cards.textEn: Pay 25 to every other active player.
